newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugoslav Feb producer prices up 1.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Yugoslav Feb producer prices up 1.9 pct.

text.p: The Federal Statistical Office reported the following economic indicator details.
YUGOSLAV PRODUCER PRICES FEB JAN FEB 1996
NOTES -- February producer prices rose 117.7 percent against the 1996 average, and were up 3.8 percent against December last year.
Cumulative January-February PPI was up 32.8 percent against the same period last year, and 16.6 percent above the average for 1996.
Figures refer to Federal Republic of Yugoslavia, comprising Serbia and Montenegro.
National Bank of Yugoslavia imposed a stabilisation programme on January 24, 1994.
